title: Integration Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar com CI/CD , versionamento e automação utilizando GitHub e GitHub Actions .
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Salesforce , incluindo:
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Apex Classes e Triggers
  • Flows
  • Experience Cloud (Builder)
  • Integração com APIs externas
  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud
  • Flosum
  • Conhecimento de objetos padrão e customizados no Salesforce.
  • Certificação AZ-204 – Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure .
  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos mobile (Apple Store e Google Play).
  • Familiaridade com Google Firebase .
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos multinacionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em integração ou tecnologias de desenvolvimento.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Vaga para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (PJ) – Topshare
description:
⚠️ ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO

APENAS CANDIDATOS COM EXPERIÊNCIA SÓLIDA E COMPROVADA EM VUE.JS E NODE.JS DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR. CANDIDATURAS SEM ESTES REQUISITOS SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.



SOBRE A TOPSHARE E O ECOSSISTEMA CREATONOMY

A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, sendo parte do grupo Creatonomy. Buscamos um profissional para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento da plataforma Topshare, além de participar ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do grupo. O foco é em soluções escaláveis e de alta performance para todo o ecossistema.

Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a inovação e a excelência técnica.


MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar como referência técnica, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções Full Stack de ponta a ponta. O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco nas stacks Vue.js (Frontend) e Node.js (Backend), e experiência obrigatória em Neo4j para modelagem de dados complexos.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1 - DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2️- DESENVOLVIMENTO DE FRONTEND E UX/UI

Desenvolver e manter interfaces de usuário modernas, responsivas e performáticas utilizando Vue.js. O profissional será responsável pela criação de novos componentes visuais reutilizáveis, garantindo a melhor experiência do usuário (UX/UI) e a consistência visual da plataforma.

3️- QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4️- DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.


✅ REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Full Stack, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis

• Proficiência em Vue.js e Node.js

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design

• Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização

• Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git


INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00/mês

Local: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:


  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e gestão de configuração como: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e alerta como: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins.
  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Auditors of Certificates of Insurance


HOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED

As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.


All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.


  • This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).
  • This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity; it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitments


Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç
  • Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
  • Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç
  • Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç
  • Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently.


WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY

  • Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
  • Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
  • Mentorship from talented leaders;
  • Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
  • Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
  • Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
  • Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.



OUR CULTURE

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.


Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:


  • We get things done, period, full stop
  • We give help generously
  • We fall in love with customer problems
  • We feel the pain, then we fix the process
  • We build trust everywhere
  • We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun



ABOUT JONES

Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.


We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.


Missão do Cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva

e sustentável.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
  • técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis

  • regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
  • a confiabilidade dos ativos
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
  • e inspeção.
  • Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
  • mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
  • Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de MoCs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
  • envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.

  • Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que

Requisitos

Camaçari- BA - Brasil

title: Senior.NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial, atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras, garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.

Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.

Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência deCompra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial, alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning, garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial, conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto, do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy, considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP, com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto.

Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply);
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência commetodologias ágeis;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail;
  • Conhecimento emOTB (Open to Buy), planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL,Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais.

O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO);
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.

Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa, conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado. É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real, influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
    ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
    monitor performance anditerate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
    CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.

PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.

KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.

SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline

Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

- Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

- Hands-on experience with API testing (e.G., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

- Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

- Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

- Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

- Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).

Day to Day

- Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

- Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

- Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

- Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

- Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar;
validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

- Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

- Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Purpose of This Position

As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. title: L3 Support Services Appendix Redhat
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE

Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

- Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

- Experience: 7–10 years

- Interview Process: 2 rounds

- Requirements: Immediate

- Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time

Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.'

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:

● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.

Sobre nós: Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.

Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.

Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local: Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda

Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.

Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR

Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.
