O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL, garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados.

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines.

Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.

Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados.

Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras).

Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. title: Cro & Marketing Specialist (Ux, Content Writing)
description:
Company Description

We are Charly, a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who is passionate about websites, data, and improving performance. This role will focus on analyzing user behavior, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing structured experimentation to improve lead generation and sales performance across our client projects.

You will work closely with our Project Managers, designers, developers, and leadership team to ensure that the websites we build are not only visually strong but also optimized to convert.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Conduct CRO audits for client websites and landing pages to identify friction points, funnel drop-offs, and conversion barriers
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, heatmaps, and session recordings
  • Identify issues related to checkout abandonment, form drop-offs, mobile UX problems, trust gaps, and messaging clarity
  • Design and implement structured A/B or multivariate experiments to improve conversion performance
  • Optimize key elements including headlines, CTAs, layouts, forms, product pages, and landing pages
  • Prepare structured audit reports with prioritized recommendations based on potential revenue impact
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and PMs to implement CRO improvements across active client projects
  • Join client and sales calls when necessary to explain CRO strategies, findings, and experiment results in clear, non-technical language
  • Continuously refine optimization strategies as new data and experiment results become available

Who this role is perfect for:

  • Someone with strong analytical thinking who can translate data into clear action steps
  • Someone who understands both UX and marketing psychology behind conversions
  • Someone comfortable running experiments and interpreting results
  • Someone who enjoys working with websites, funnels, and digital products
  • Someone proactive who can identify improvement opportunities without waiting for direction
  • Someone comfortable collaborating with designers, developers, and project managers in a remote team environment
  • Someone fluent in English and confident communicating with clients
  • Based in Latin America

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote role in a growing digital agency
  • Flexible work environment with a distributed international team
  • Opportunity to work on multiple websites and client projects across different industries
  • Direct collaboration with leadership, PMs, designers, and developers
  • Long-term role with the opportunity to shape CRO processes as the agency scales

To Apply:

To apply, send your CV and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to with the subject line:

\ "CRO & Marketing Specialist Application - (Your Full Name)\ "

In your video, briefly cover who you are, your marketing and CRO background, and one result or project you are proud of.

Applications submitted via LinkedIn will NOT be considered. Please ensure you meet the listed qualifications before applying.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;
DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

\ "We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  • Application review
  • Technical conversation
  • Architecture discussion
  • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.G., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required;
    proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don't meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.

What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners.   • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.

This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.

Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead Dba
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:

Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role;
we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\ " expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.

What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.

2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.

Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required;
    comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don't meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Senior Database Administrator — Oltp & Olap Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases

Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.

What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration

Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.X
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Remote ai quality analyst (japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience:
Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:
Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms. Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Software engineering manager
description:
Who we are
We're a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we'll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let's see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As an Engineering Manager, you'll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.
You will:
Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team. About the right team member
You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.
You'll thrive in this role with experience in:
3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Business development manager – industrial market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.
Hikvision possesses the world's largest R& D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision's customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.
Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
Country: Brazil
The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.
The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:
•Great business sense and market sense
•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market
•Great communication skills
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•A positive attitude
•Great negotiation skills
•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity
Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:
•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys
•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points
•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users
•Presentation of the solution to potential customers
•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.
•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team
•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.
•Assist consultants to specify projects
•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.
•Prepare reports required by the management.
Your Profile:
•Experience in the industrial market.
•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.
•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.
•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•Strong communication skills in English,both oral and written
•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Desenvolvedor servicenow | especialista técnico de aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):
O desenvolvedor Service Now fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do Service Now. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:
Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.
Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.
Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.
Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.
Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).
Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.
Integrar o APM com outros módulos do Service Now, incluindo ITSM e SAM.
Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.
Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.
Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.
Qualificações e Requisitos
Qualificações essenciais
• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada
• Certificação Service Now System Administrator (CSA)
• Certificação Service Now Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer
• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos
Competências-chave
8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI
Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e Java Script
Experiência na plataforma Service Now como Administrador e Desenvolvedor
Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB
Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração Service Now nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável
Outras habilidades e competências
Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão
Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

description:

Estamos em busca de um PLM Consultant para atuar em projetos de consultoria e implementação utilizando a suíte PTC Windchill. Esse profissional será responsável por apoiar iniciativas de Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e contribuindo para a entrega de soluções eficientes para clientes globais.

• Apoiar projetos de consultoria e implementação de PLM utilizando PTC Windchill

• Garantir qualidade seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software

• Conhecimento em administração de sistemas, Windows Server e Linux (Red Hat)

title: Customer success associate
description:
About Ad Manage.ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Ad Manage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.
The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.
We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with Ad Manage.ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.
What You'll Do
Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions. What We're Looking For
At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a Saa S company).
Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable. Bonus Points For
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or Tik Tok Ads at a campaign level
Any exposure to Saa S tools or ad tech platforms
Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, Tik Tok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns. Why Join Us
Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor. How to Apply Send your Linked In and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Opentext consultant
description:
Open Text VIM/OCR Expert - Remote working - English Speaking
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Open Text VIM for automated vendor invoice processing.
Configure and support invoice capture, OCR extraction, validation, workflow routing, and posting to SAP FI/MM.
Implement and optimize Open Text Intelligent Capture Center (ICC) or equivalent OCR tools for invoice data extraction.
Configure VIM Document Processing (DP), exception handling, and workflow approvals.
Integrate VIM with SAP S/4 HANA Accounts Payable, PO invoice processing, and vendor master data.
Support Archive Link/Content Server integration for document storage and retrieval.
Assist with system testing, integration testing, and go-live readiness.
Troubleshoot issues related to OCR extraction, invoice matching, workflow processing, and FI posting errors.
Support go-live and hypercare activities, including improving touchless invoice processing rates.

title: Pessoa gerente financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.
Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:
Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.
Faturamento (Billing):
Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (Saa S/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.
Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:
Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.
Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria:
Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
Compras e Gestão de Custos:
Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.
Controles Internos e Compliance:
Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.
Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:
Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.
Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver:
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas Saa S ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de Saa S (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on Linked In and Google, you'll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.

Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
Launch, manage, and optimize B2 B campaigns on Linked In Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects. Skills & Qualifications:
5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2 B environments.
Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on Linked In Ads and Google Ads.
Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalents.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast. Nice-to-Haves:
Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE
Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4 HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.
KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
Experience in S/4 HANA environment and Fiori applications.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks. WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis. We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.
