Youtube
Privacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Data analyst v
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL
Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência
Modelo de trabalho: Home office
Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.
O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.
O que você fará
Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics. Qualificações Mínimas
Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis
Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark).
Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Desenvolvedor rpa sênior – automation anywhere
description:
A Practia está presente em 9 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.
Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da Ui Path, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (Ui Path Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da Ui Path.
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico, integrando um time de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.
Essa pessoa atuará de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a revisão da documentação funcional, avaliação de complexidade, suporte ao design e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento das automações, sustentação, monitoramento, implantação em produção e apoio ao período de hypercare.
Além disso, será treinada em nosso framework proprietário e metodologia de Hyperautomação Smart BPA, que cobre toda a jornada — do Discovery à implementação do COE.
Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.
O que buscamos
Profissional sênior, com forte experiência em desenvolvimento e sustentação de automações.
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e com visão de qualidade e governança.

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Pessoa cientista de dados - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas O que nós estamos procurando:
Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações O que oferecemos:
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico

Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.

Competitive salary and benefits.

A collaborative and innovative work environment.

Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.

Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados. Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.

Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.

Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

description:

A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais

Vale Alimentação

title: Especialista em customer success / account manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin, somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.
É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco. Relacionamento Consultivo
Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução. Operação & Execução
Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades. Requisitos e qualificações
Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
Conhecimento de métricas Saa S (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (Hub Spot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos. Desejáveis
Experiência com produtos Saa S B2 B;
Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: Wb D, Success Playbooks). Diferenciais
Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG);
Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado. Cultura de Cliente
Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

Company Description
Sofia Health is a U. S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.
We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, Linked In, social media, and podcast channels.

The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.
This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.
The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.

Nosso método une comunicação prática, comportamento e estratégia — sem ensino tradicional.

Modelo PJ, com foco em performance.

Conduzir conversas com clareza e segurança
Identificar dores e objetivos rapidamente

Fechar com naturalidade (sem pressão)
Disponibilidade para atender e responder leads com agilidade, conforme o momento do cliente
Experiência com vendas consultivas
Experiência com cold call, ligações e atendimento via mensagem
Boa comunicação (fala e escuta)
Organização e uso de CRM
Noções práticas de uso de IA no dia a dia Perfil que buscamos
Pessoa ágil, comprometida com resultado e que responde rápido, assume responsabilidade e não precisa ser cobrada para performar.

title: Analista fiscal
description:
Buscamos profissional com experiência na área fiscal, com atuação em empresas optantes pelo Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido, preferencialmente com vivência em empresas do segmento da saúde.
Principais responsabilidades:
• Realizar apuração e conferência de tributos federais, estaduais e municipais;
• Elaborar e analisar obrigações acessórias fiscais;
• Executar entrega de declarações como ECD, ECF, DCTF, DIRF, EFD-Reinf e EFD Contribuições;
• Realizar apuração de IRPJ e CSLL para empresas do Lucro Presumido (prestação de serviços);
• Conferir retenções tributárias e lançamentos fiscais;
• Garantir conformidade fiscal e cumprimento dos prazos legais;
• Apoiar análises tributárias e rotinas de regularização fiscal.
Perfil desejado:
• Experiência prévia na área fiscal;
• Conhecimento em legislação tributária aplicada ao setor de serviços;
• Desejável vivência com empresas da área da saúde;
• Organização, atenção analítica e responsabilidade com prazos.
CRC ATIVO Imprescindível conhecimento sistema Domínio.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:We're looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop, schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks. What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models...
Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our " Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level
To Apply Submit:
Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history
If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview Requirements Before Employment
Signed Confidentiality agreement
Signed Non-compete agreement
Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form Company Culture
Remote
We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
Hours 8 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.

Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.

Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Estudos de legislação estrangeira na esfera administrativa e jurídica;

Atuação com estruturas de holding e a legislação aplicável a empresas internacionais;
Interface com clientes (troca de e-mail, mensagens e telefonema);
Interface com parceiros no exterior. Diferenciais:

title: Frontend engineer – next.js / react
description:
Frontend Engineer – Next.js / React
Type: Full-Time
About Admanage.ai
We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Admanage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend. Our mission? Level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
We make it easy to launch hundreds of ads in seconds, saving advertisers hours. And we're building AI-powered tools to programmatically create, launch, and manage ads, which is where you come in.
We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience, not just ideas. We commit to Git Hub multiple times a day and ship continuously.
Why This Role Rocks
This is a senior-level frontend role where you'll design and deliver features that directly impact how the top advertisers launch and manage hundreds of thousands of ads per month. You'll collaborate with the founding team (ex-Photoroom, ex-ZOE, ex-Nextdoor), shape our frontend architecture, and raise the bar for state management, testing, and performance.
You're not here to maintain, you're here to build a complex UI that's robust and well-tested.
Tech Stack
Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion
State Management: Zustand
Testing: Vitest
Backend (light exposure): Node.js, Prisma, My SQL
Infra: R2 Cloudfalre, AWS S3, Vercel
Auth: Next Auth.js
APIs: Facebook Marketing API, Tik Tok Ads API
What You'll Do
Architect and scale the frontend for an app launching 900,000+ ads/month
Implement robust state management to handle complex, async, and data-heavy workflows
Build production-grade testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2 E) to support safe continuous deployment
Ship features end-to-end: idea → build → optimize for robust testing, speed and UX
You Might Be a Fit If You...
Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.js apps
Are skilled at state management in large, complex apps
Believe testing is part of building, not an afterthought
Care about performance, UX, and clean design systems
Communicate clearly, move fast, and thrive in a startup culture
Bonus Points For
Experience with ad APIs (Meta, Tik Tok, IG)
Prisma + My SQL experience
CI/CD pipeline knowledge (Vercel, Git Hub Actions)
Join Us If You Want To...
Build alongside experienced engineers and founders
Work with a modern stack and ship fast
Solve hard UX and state management challenges in adtech
Own what you build and shape our engineering culture
Grow into a Lead role as the company scales
How to Apply
Send your Git Hub, Linked In, and 2-3 lines on the hardest frontend problem you've solved lately. Bonus: links to anything you've built that makes you proud.
Interview Process
We start with a take home task where you'll be asked to identify bugs in a sample github repo and indicate how you would fix it.

title: Especialista em customer success / account manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin, somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.
É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco. Relacionamento Consultivo
Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução. Operação & Execução
Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades. Requisitos e qualificações
Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
Conhecimento de métricas Saa S (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (Hub Spot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos. Desejáveis
Experiência com produtos Saa S B2 B;
Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: Wb D, Success Playbooks). Diferenciais
Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG);
Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado. Cultura de Cliente
Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar

As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.

title: Content operations specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.
Company Description
Sofia Health is a U. S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.
We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, Linked In, social media, and podcast channels.
Role Description
The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.
This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.
The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.
What You Will Do
Content & Provider Curation
Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities Cross-Channel Content Management
Plan and coordinate content across:
Email marketing
Blog
Linked In
Social media
Podcast promotions
Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces Podcast & Media Coordination
Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
Episode launch coordination
Provider or guest features
Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently Coordination & Execution Flow
Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
Email upload and formatting support
Social scheduling support
Podcast and blog publishing
Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking
Monitor inbound interest generated from content
Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
Track engagement and performance across channels
Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings Who You Are
Highly organized and detail-oriented
Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
Process-driven and systems-oriented
Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams Qualifications
Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field

title: Contract clinical research associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)
Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.
About Clinergy
Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.
Role Description
We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.
Activities
Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
Verify the accuracy of study results;
Identify and resolve site issues; Requirements
Bachelor's degree in life sciences;
2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
Advanced/Fluent in English;
Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices Skills
Self driven individual
Sense of urgency
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Good problem solving skills
Enthusiastic and energetic To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to
Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass

Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems What we are looking for:Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.
Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment What we offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental

Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.
